definition: This dimension controls the speed at which hunger or resource levels decrease, influencing how urgently players must seek sustenance. Variations can range from slow depletion, allowing for more exploration, to rapid depletion, pushing players towards immediate action.
exclusion_criteria: Static resources that do not deplete
Mechanics that allow indefinite stalling without consequences
inclusion_criteria: The rate of resource consumption affects gameplay pacing
Players must frequently seek food or resources to survive
title: Depletion Rate of Hunger Clock
